description:
About the job

Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?

At  Aleph , we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.

Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.

With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.

Ready to accelerate your career in Gaming? Want to shape the future of advertising on Roblox?

We are looking for a high-energy, AI-native Client Partner to join our team at Aleph, focusing specifically on Roblox in Mexico.

If you live and breathe technology, love the gaming industry, and use AI tools to supercharge your daily life, this is the perfect place to build your future.

Who You Are

We are looking for a dynamic professional who brings a fresh perspective, immense drive, and a passion for innovation.



Growth Mindset: You are eager to fast-track your professional journey, master new skills at lightning speed, and make a tangible impact from day one. 
"Full AI" Oriented: You don't just know what AI is, it’s woven into how you think and work. You actively use tools like Gemini, Claude, or automation to learn, create, and organize your workflow. You are always looking for ways to leverage AI to work smarter. 
Tech or Gaming Enthusiast: You have a deep, genuine passion for the gaming industry (if you understand or play Roblox, that's a massive plus!) and you naturally gravitate toward the latest tech trends. 
High Energy & Hyper-Adaptable: The digital ad world moves fast, and Aleph moves faster. You thrive in environments of constant change, pivot smoothly when priorities shift, and bring infectious positive energy to the team. 



What You’ll Do

As a Client Partner for Roblox, you will be at the intersection of brands, gaming, and cutting-edge ad tech:



Help brands and agencies understand the power of Roblox and how to build successful campaigns. 
Use AI tools to optimize your workflow, build pitches, analyze data, and stay ahead of the curve. 
Manage client relationships with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. 
Collaborate with a global, fast-paced team where innovation is celebrated. 



Why Join Us?



The Brand: Represent Roblox, one of the most exciting and dynamic platforms in the world. 
The Culture: At Aleph, change is our constant. You will be surrounded by brilliant minds in a flexible, high-growth environment. 
The Future: We don't just tolerate AI; we expect you to push the boundaries of how it's used to elevate your daily work. 



 Ready to jump in? If you are energetic, adaptable, and ready to kickstart your growth at the intersection of AI and Gaming, let’s talk!

Why Join Us?

Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.

We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.

#ALEPH

We use Lever, our recruitment management platform, which includes AI-powered features that may assist our hiring team in reviewing applications, analyzing CVs, and identifying relevant qualifications. These tools support - but do not replace - human judgement. All hiring decisions are made by people. For more information about how your personal data is processed, including your rights in relation to AI-assisted processing, please see our Candidate Privacy Policy or contact us at [email protected] .

title: Sr. Creative Designer (Performance Marketing) - Static & Motion
skills: Own paid static for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.
Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform's specs and native feel.
Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets, from 9:16 sound-on to static-adjacent 1:1 and 4:5.
Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video and imagery, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn't.
Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

Version and localize at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you'll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

Build creative that's designed to be tested. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.
Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.
Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.
5+ years in performance creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

A portfolio that proves it, submitted with your application. Paid static above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you're able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.
Layout, hierarchy, type and composition that hold up at thumbnail size, in feed, and in multiple languages.
Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.
Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.
High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.

Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You're fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.
Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic timing and an instinct for what's about to feel dated.
Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.
Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with layouts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.
A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.
Figma and Adobe CC (After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop) as well as strong genAI skills
Curious about investing and crypto at a minimum, and able to make the space legible to others.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, static and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

Paid static is the center of the role, but we're hiring a hybrid rather than a specialist: this means you also ideate and create performance video and treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

description:
About the job

BAT está evolucionando rápidamente hacia un negocio global de múltiples categorías. Nuestra misión es reducir el impacto que nuestra industria tiene en la salud.

Para alcanzar nuestra ambición, estamos buscando compañeros preparados para Ser el Cambio. ¡Ven, únete a nosotros en este viaje!

British American Tobacco México tiene una oportunidad emocionante como Trade Marketing Convenience Intern en Querétaro 

Tus responsabilidades incluirán 


Administrar y actualizar bases de información de mercado provenientes de Nielsen, clientes y fuentes internas.
Preparar resúmenes ejecutivos, dashboards y presentaciones con principales hallazgos, oportunidades y recomendaciones para foros internos.
Apoyar en el análisis de sell in, sell out, inventarios, distribución y desempeño de portafolio.
Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento a través del análisis de mix de portafolio, distribución, disponibilidad y productividad por tienda/SKU.
Dar seguimiento a iniciativas comerciales, activaciones y planes tácticos implementados en clientes de Convenience.
Apoyar en la medición de resultados y efectividad de actividades comerciales, incluyendo análisis de ROI e incrementalidad cuando aplique.


¿Qué buscamos? 


Estudiante activo de las carreras de Marketing, Negocios, Administración o afines; con graduación proyectada para diciembre de 2027 o fecha posterior. 
Nivel de inglés avanzado.
Nivel intermedio avanzado en Excel y PowerPoint. 
Perfil analítico, proactivo y creativo, con capacidad para gestionar y analizar grandes bases de datos, transformando información en insights accionables para la toma de decisiones. Orientado a resultados y con pensamiento comercial, destacando por la habilidad para estructurar presentaciones ejecutivas, comunicar hallazgos de forma clara y sencilla, coordinar múltiples proyectos simultáneamente y mantener una constante curiosidad por comprender el comportamiento del shopper, los clientes y la dinámica del canal Convenience.
Disponibilidad para trabajar de forma presencial. 


QUÉ TE OFRECEMOS?


Tu crecimiento profesional con nosotros no tiene límites; Está impulsado por tus aspiraciones. Únete a BAT y forma parte de un entorno que fomenta el avance interno, donde la progresión de tu carrera no es solo una declaración de intenciones, es una realidad que estamos ansiosos por construir juntos. Aprovecha la oportunidad y toma las riendas de tu desarrollo; Tu próximo capítulo comienza aquí.
Priorizamos la mejora continua dentro de un entorno transformador, lo que nos prepara para el cambio constante. 


POR QUÉ UNIRTE A BAT?

Somos una de las pocas empresas nombradas como uno de los Mejores Empleadores Globales por el Instituto “Top Employers”, certificados por ofrecer excelentes condiciones laborales.

La colaboración, la inclusión y la asociación son la base de todo lo que hacemos en BAT. Nuestra finalidad es permitir que cada individuo prospere, independientemente de su género, orientación sexual, estado civil o de pareja, reasignación de género, raza, religión o creencia, color, nacionalidad, origen étnico o nacional, discapacidad, edad, habilidades, experiencia, educación, antecedentes socioeconómicos y profesionales, estado de veterano, perspectivas y formas de pensar. Sabemos que abrazar todo tipo de talento es lo que nos hace más fuertes y mejor preparados para cumplir nuestros objetivos comerciales.

Consideramos las pausas en la carrera profesional como oportunidades, no obstáculos. A través del programa Global Returners, apoyamos a profesionales que buscan reiniciar sus carreras después de una ausencia prolongada en el mercado laboral (por ejemplo, tiempo dedicado al cuidado de la familia, permisos parentales, servicio nacional, sabático y/o inicio de un propio emprendimiento).

Ven, aporta tu diferencia y descubre todas las posibilidades que tenemos para ti en BAT. Obtén más información sobre nuestra cultura y nuestra galardonada experiencia laboral aquí.

Si necesitas ajustes razonables o acuerdos para ayudarte a rendir al máximo durante el proceso de selección, te animamos a que nos lo notifiques. Estamos totalmente comprometidos a apoyarte para que puedas demostrar todo tu potencial.

title: Marketing Content Specialist - Remote Work
description:
About the job

At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.




Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.




When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.




Marketing Content Specialist at BairesDev




In this role, you'll develop, validate, and optimize the content and data that power the enterprise, ensuring accurate, compelling, and client-focused materials for commercial teams. Combining strategic thinking, AI-powered content creation, and cross-functional collaboration, you'll uncover valuable project insights and improve the quality of our data.




What You'll Do:




- Produce content including presentation outlines.

- Curate data through research, context gathering, and organized storage.

- Build and manage systems for content intake, processing, and optimization.

- Maintain documentation, guidelines, and content libraries.

- Monitor online reputation and brand presence.




What we are looking for:




- 3+ years of experience producing B2B marketing content.

- 2+ years of experience in B2B or tech roles.

- 1+ year of experience with AI tool usage and integration.

- 1+ year of experience in the technology industry.

- Advanced proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- 1+ year of experience writing about technology.




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.




Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

title: Paid Search Specialist
skills: Build, launch, and maintain Paid Search/Shopping campaigns aligned to client objectives, audience, and inventory realities; surface trade‑offs and clarifying questions early.
Prepare clear, on‑time performance updates and inputs for QBRs with actionable next steps.
Operate platform tooling (Google/Microsoft Ads, SA360/Skai), audience/keyword tools, and feed basics; apply automation responsibly (e.g., smart bidding, Performance Max) with guidance.
Pull and interpret Bliss Point signals (e.g., Forecasting, Always‑On Incrementality, Creative Insights) to inform day‑to‑day optimizations; log issues and feedback to product/analytics channels.
Monitor daily/weekly performance; build accurate recurring reports; run basic A/B tests with defined success criteria; maintain pacing and budgets.
Execute tagging and feed QA checklists; partner with Analytics to validate reads and resolve anomalies.
Demonstrate sound channel craft and growing cross‑channel awareness; connect measurement to growth; follow and help refine team playbooks and SOPs.
Manage a clear work queue; deliver on time; proactively flag risks/blockers; reduce rework and non‑converting spend; close the loop with documented learnings.
Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace technology and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Lead with precision, innovation, and proof.
Culture of ownership: Act with speed, reduce waste, and own outcomes end‑to‑end.
Experience: 2–3 years executing and managing Paid Search/Shopping (builds, launches, pacing, optimizations); monthly budgets ~$50K+.
Platform fluency: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Merchant Center; SA360 or Skai; competitive tools (Auction Insights; familiarity with Adalysis/Adthena/SpyFu).
Analytics: GA/GA4 and advanced Excel/Sheets (pivots, lookups); able to create clear performance narratives and basic test readouts.
Communication and collaboration: Clear written/verbal status updates; cross‑functional teamwork in a Pod; receptive to coaching and able to “manage up.”
Certifications: Google Search & Shopping (or completed in the first 60 days). Additional Google certifications are a strong advantage.
Delivery excellence: On‑time, accurate launches and reporting; clean QA (low defect rate).
Efficient growth support: Day‑to‑day optimizations that support efficiency KPIs while contributing to revenue goals.
Waste reduction: Decrease non‑converting queries; improve feed/tagging fidelity.
Product/AI usage: Adopt relevant automation and Bliss Point insights with documented impact.
Experimentation: Execute prioritized tests with clear success criteria and learnings.
Collaboration & communication: Clear handoffs, risk flags, and QBR inputs that inform decisions.
description:
About the job

Who We Are

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Paid Search Specialist, you will execute and optimize Paid Search and Shopping campaigns to drive efficient client growth. You’ll build high‑quality account structures, translate performance data into clear next actions, and apply automation and Bliss Point insights under guidance to reduce waste and improve outcomes. You’ll set and deliver Rocks with directional KPIs, partner across your Pod (Channel SMEs, Analytics, Creative, Client Leads, Product/Bliss Point), and continuously document and improve your workflows. We align scope and expectations to our job architecture for consistency and transparent progression.

Key Responsibilities

Client‑Centric


Build, launch, and maintain Paid Search/Shopping campaigns aligned to client objectives, audience, and inventory realities; surface trade‑offs and clarifying questions early.
Prepare clear, on‑time performance updates and inputs for QBRs with actionable next steps.


Product‑Led


Operate platform tooling (Google/Microsoft Ads, SA360/Skai), audience/keyword tools, and feed basics; apply automation responsibly (e.g., smart bidding, Performance Max) with guidance.
Pull and interpret Bliss Point signals (e.g., Forecasting, Always‑On Incrementality, Creative Insights) to inform day‑to‑day optimizations; log issues and feedback to product/analytics channels.


Data & Measurement‑Driven


Monitor daily/weekly performance; build accurate recurring reports; run basic A/B tests with defined success criteria; maintain pacing and budgets.
Execute tagging and feed QA checklists; partner with Analytics to validate reads and resolve anomalies.


The Tinuiti Way


Demonstrate sound channel craft and growing cross‑channel awareness; connect measurement to growth; follow and help refine team playbooks and SOPs.


Owner Mindset


Manage a clear work queue; deliver on time; proactively flag risks/blockers; reduce rework and non‑converting spend; close the loop with documented learnings.


Ways of working and values


Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace technology and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Lead with precision, innovation, and proof.
Culture of ownership: Act with speed, reduce waste, and own outcomes end‑to‑end.


Professional & Technical Qualifications


Experience: 2–3 years executing and managing Paid Search/Shopping (builds, launches, pacing, optimizations); monthly budgets ~$50K+.
Platform fluency: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Merchant Center; SA360 or Skai; competitive tools (Auction Insights; familiarity with Adalysis/Adthena/SpyFu).
Analytics: GA/GA4 and advanced Excel/Sheets (pivots, lookups); able to create clear performance narratives and basic test readouts.
Communication and collaboration: Clear written/verbal status updates; cross‑functional teamwork in a Pod; receptive to coaching and able to “manage up.”
Certifications: Google Search & Shopping (or completed in the first 60 days). Additional Google certifications are a strong advantage.


KPIs


Delivery excellence: On‑time, accurate launches and reporting; clean QA (low defect rate).
Efficient growth support: Day‑to‑day optimizations that support efficiency KPIs while contributing to revenue goals.
Waste reduction: Decrease non‑converting queries; improve feed/tagging fidelity.
Product/AI usage: Adopt relevant automation and Bliss Point insights with documented impact.
Experimentation: Execute prioritized tests with clear success criteria and learnings.
Collaboration & communication: Clear handoffs, risk flags, and QBR inputs that inform decisions.


We operate on a flexible hybrid model, but we love seeing our team! For this role, we ask that you come into our great office in Reforma, CDMX, two days a week. This is an essential part of how we collaborate and connect, so candidates should be comfortable with this regular in-office commitment.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Benefits

Unlimited PTO: At Tinuiti, we believe you deserve time to rest, recharge, and enjoy life unplugged. When you prioritize time for yourself, you're able to bring your best self to work. That’s why we offer unlimited paid time off, a hybrid work environment, and flexibility to take the time you need, when you need it. On top of that, we provide 16 paid holidays, including multiple long weekends, to ensure you have dedicated time to step away and disconnect. We're proud to offer above-industry standard work-life balance, consistently rated as one of the most loved benefits by Tinuitians year after year.

Healthcare: Major Medical (including dental and vision coverage), Minor Medical, Life Insurance Retirement: We offer a Savings Fund which includes a 10% employer match (10% employee contribution required for participation)

Perks and Wellness: Thankful giving, Equity

Parental Leave: Birthing parents receive 16 weeks of leave with 100% pay, consisting of 12 weeks statutory leave and 4 additional paid weeks through company policy. Non-birthing parents will receive 6 weeks of leave with 100% pay.

Learning and Development: On-demand learning (powered by LinkedIn Learning), mentorship program, leadership and management development programs and resources

Disclaimer: This description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this position. The actual duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may vary based on assignment or group. Tinuiti is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status.

title: Supervisor(a) de Redes Sociales y Marca Empleadora
description:
About the job

¿Cómo es el día a día de la posición?

Como Supervisor(a) de Redes Sociales y Marca Empleadora en Deloitte serás responsable de gestionar la presencia digital de la marca empleadora en redes sociales, administrando y programando publicaciones alineadas con la estrategia de contenidos. Darás seguimiento a la interacción con la comunidad mediante la gestión de comentarios, mensajes e iniciativas de engagement, fortaleciendo la conexión con candidatos y audiencias clave. Asimismo, monitorearás indicadores de desempeño, elaborarás reportes e identificarás insights que permitan optimizar la estrategia con base en datos y tendencias del mercado. También participarás en la creación de contenido y redacción de copys, así como en la cobertura de eventos e iniciativas de talento para amplificar su alcance e impacto en los distintos canales digitales.

Trabajarás en un ambiente dinámico y enriquecedor con personas de diferentes culturas, perspectivas, especialidades y conocimientos. Juntos(as), creamos soluciones únicas y de calidad, superando las expectativas y alcance de nuestros proyectos y clientes. Nos motiva generar un impacto significativo en todo lo que hacemos.




¿Qué se necesita para aplicar?

• Titulado(a) de Mercadotecnia, Comunicación o Relaciones Públicas,

• 4 a 6 años de experiencia en employer branding, gestión de redes sociales y camapañas digitales,

• Inglés avanzado,

• Herramientas tecnológicas: Paquetería Office,

• Habilidades: Capacidad de análisis, comunicación efectiva, organización, adaptabilidad, orientación a resultados, alta calidad, negociación, solución de problemas y afición por la tecnología




¿Por qué Deloitte?

Con nuestro trabajo creamos un impacto significativo, que marca una diferencia positiva en nuestros(as) clientes, la sociedad y el planeta. Colaboramos en distintos proyectos con personas que nos escuchan, inspiran, alientan y apoyan a dar lo mejor de nosotros(as) mismos(as).

Para Deloitte, nuestro desarrollo integral es una prioridad. A través de las oportunidades de aprendizaje, movilidad, voluntariado y la asesoría personalizada de nuestros(as) líderes, crecemos en nuestras carreras y formamos lazos que perduran.




Siguientes pasos

¿Estas listo(a) para crear un impacto? Te estamos buscando, postúlate.




#Deloitte

description:
About the job

Who We Are

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Paid Search Specialist, you will execute and optimize Paid Search and Shopping campaigns to drive efficient client growth. You’ll build high‑quality account structures, translate performance data into clear next actions, and apply automation and Bliss Point insights under guidance to reduce waste and improve outcomes. You’ll set and deliver Rocks with directional KPIs, partner across your Pod (Channel SMEs, Analytics, Creative, Client Leads, Product/Bliss Point), and continuously document and improve your workflows. We align scope and expectations to our job architecture for consistency and transparent progression.

Key Responsibilities

Client‑Centric


Build, launch, and maintain Paid Search/Shopping campaigns aligned to client objectives, audience, and inventory realities; surface trade‑offs and clarifying questions early.
Prepare clear, on‑time performance updates and inputs for QBRs with actionable next steps.


Product‑Led


Operate platform tooling (Google/Microsoft Ads, SA360/Skai), audience/keyword tools, and feed basics; apply automation responsibly (e.g., smart bidding, Performance Max) with guidance.
Pull and interpret Bliss Point signals (e.g., Forecasting, Always‑On Incrementality, Creative Insights) to inform day‑to‑day optimizations; log issues and feedback to product/analytics channels.


Data & Measurement‑Driven


Monitor daily/weekly performance; build accurate recurring reports; run basic A/B tests with defined success criteria; maintain pacing and budgets.
Execute tagging and feed QA checklists; partner with Analytics to validate reads and resolve anomalies.


The Tinuiti Way


Demonstrate sound channel craft and growing cross‑channel awareness; connect measurement to growth; follow and help refine team playbooks and SOPs.


Owner Mindset


Manage a clear work queue; deliver on time; proactively flag risks/blockers; reduce rework and non‑converting spend; close the loop with documented learnings.


Ways of working and values


Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace technology and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Lead with precision, innovation, and proof.
Culture of ownership: Act with speed, reduce waste, and own outcomes end‑to‑end.


Professional & Technical Qualifications


Experience: 2–3 years executing and managing Paid Search/Shopping (builds, launches, pacing, optimizations); monthly budgets ~$50K+.
Platform fluency: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Merchant Center; SA360 or Skai; competitive tools (Auction Insights; familiarity with Adalysis/Adthena/SpyFu).
Analytics: GA/GA4 and advanced Excel/Sheets (pivots, lookups); able to create clear performance narratives and basic test readouts.
Communication and collaboration: Clear written/verbal status updates; cross‑functional teamwork in a Pod; receptive to coaching and able to “manage up.”
Certifications: Google Search & Shopping (or completed in the first 60 days). Additional Google certifications are a strong advantage.


KPIs


Delivery excellence: On‑time, accurate launches and reporting; clean QA (low defect rate).
Efficient growth support: Day‑to‑day optimizations that support efficiency KPIs while contributing to revenue goals.
Waste reduction: Decrease non‑converting queries; improve feed/tagging fidelity.
Product/AI usage: Adopt relevant automation and Bliss Point insights with documented impact.
Experimentation: Execute prioritized tests with clear success criteria and learnings.
Collaboration & communication: Clear handoffs, risk flags, and QBR inputs that inform decisions.


We operate on a flexible hybrid model, but we love seeing our team! For this role, we ask that you come into our great office in Reforma, CDMX, two days a week. This is an essential part of how we collaborate and connect, so candidates should be comfortable with this regular in-office commitment.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Benefits

Unlimited PTO: At Tinuiti, we believe you deserve time to rest, recharge, and enjoy life unplugged. When you prioritize time for yourself, you're able to bring your best self to work. That’s why we offer unlimited paid time off, a hybrid work environment, and flexibility to take the time you need, when you need it. On top of that, we provide 16 paid holidays, including multiple long weekends, to ensure you have dedicated time to step away and disconnect. We're proud to offer above-industry standard work-life balance, consistently rated as one of the most loved benefits by Tinuitians year after year.

Healthcare: Major Medical (including dental and vision coverage), Minor Medical, Life Insurance Retirement: We offer a Savings Fund which includes a 10% employer match (10% employee contribution required for participation)

Perks and Wellness: Thankful giving, Equity

Parental Leave: Birthing parents receive 16 weeks of leave with 100% pay, consisting of 12 weeks statutory leave and 4 additional paid weeks through company policy. Non-birthing parents will receive 6 weeks of leave with 100% pay.

Learning and Development: On-demand learning (powered by LinkedIn Learning), mentorship program, leadership and management development programs and resources

The actual duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may vary based on assignment or group. Tinuiti is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status.

title: Growth Media Specialist
skills: Develop and execute performance marketing strategies: Plan, implement, and optimize multi-channel campaigns (paid social, PPC, display advertising, etc.) to meet acquisition, conversion, and ROI goals.

Expertise in Google Ads and/or Facebook Ads Manager, as well as analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Adobe Analytics
Advanced computer skills, particularly Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Google Suite Products (Google Slides, Google Sheets, etc.)
Hands on experience in managing monthly campaign budgets from $30k+
Client management and client-facing experience desirable
Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret complex data to derive actionable insights.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities and strategies.
Certifications in Google Ads, Facebook Blueprint, or other relevant platforms are desirable.
Ecommerce and agency experience desirable

title: Marketing Content Specialist - Remote Work
description:
About the job

At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.




Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.




When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.




Marketing Content Specialist at BairesDev




In this role, you'll develop, validate, and optimize the content and data that power the enterprise, ensuring accurate, compelling, and client-focused materials for commercial teams. Combining strategic thinking, AI-powered content creation, and cross-functional collaboration, you'll uncover valuable project insights and improve the quality of our data.




What You'll Do:




- Produce content including presentation outlines.

- Curate data through research, context gathering, and organized storage.

- Build and manage systems for content intake, processing, and optimization.

- Maintain documentation, guidelines, and content libraries.

- Monitor online reputation and brand presence.




What we are looking for:




- 3+ years of experience producing B2B marketing content.

- 2+ years of experience in B2B or tech roles.

- 1+ year of experience with AI tool usage and integration.

- 1+ year of experience in the technology industry.

- Advanced proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- 1+ year of experience writing about technology.




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.




Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

Detail Magnet: Small setup errors jump out at you instantly.

Our customers come back because the products work and the service is good.




We launch a lot of creative every week. The people who do well here are the ones who keep that machine clean.




Sound like you?




Apply now, and we'll be in touch soon.

About the job

Business Development Representative | SaaS, FinTech & Tecnología | Prospección Outbound & Eventos 

Para nuestro cliente, una empresa internacional de tecnología especializada en comunicaciones en la nube, soluciones de contact center y automatización de interacciones con clientes, estamos en búsqueda de un/a Business Development Representative (BDR) – Outbound B2B para integrarse a su equipo comercial en México.




Esta posición es ideal para una persona con mentalidad hunter, experiencia en prospección outbound y capacidad para generar nuevas oportunidades comerciales en sectores B2B, especialmente dentro de tecnología, SaaS, fintech, contact center, CPaaS o soluciones de comunicación empresarial.

La persona seleccionada será responsable de identificar y contactar empresas objetivo, abrir conversaciones con tomadores de decisión, calificar oportunidades y agendar reuniones comerciales para el equipo, manteniendo una gestión ordenada y precisa del pipeline en CRM.




LO QUE BUSCAMOS EN NUESTRO/A CANDIDATO/A IDEAL:

1. A partir de 2+ años de experiencia en roles de prospección comercial, generación de leads outbound o desarrollo de ventas B2B. 

2. Experiencia deseable en sectores como tecnología B2B, SaaS, Fintech, contact center, CPaaS, cloud communications, soluciones digitales o servicios tecnológicos para empresas. 

3. Experiencia previa como Representante Comercial, Ejecutivo Comercial, SDR, BDR, Sales Development, Lead Generation o posiciones similares.

4. Mentalidad hunter y fuerte orientación a resultados, con comodidad para hacer contacto en frío, buscar nuevos prospectos y abrir puertas con tomadores de decisión. 

5. Capacidad para identificar empresas objetivo, entender el perfil de cliente ideal y calificar oportunidades comerciales de manera estructurada. 

6. Buenas habilidades de comunicación para explicar soluciones tecnológicas de forma clara, consultiva y profesional. 

7. Experiencia trabajando con CRM, registrando actividades, conversaciones, próximos pasos y avance de oportunidades de manera ordenada y constante. 

8. Perfil organizado, proactivo, coachable y con actitud madura para representar a la empresa en primeras conversaciones comerciales y eventos de la industria. 

9. Inglés intermedio, suficiente para comunicarse con equipo internacional y entender información comercial del producto. 




FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES DEL PUESTO:

1) Realizar prospección outbound a empresas objetivo definidas por la compañía. 

2) Contactar a prospectos a través de canales como LinkedIn, email, llamadas y otros medios comerciales. 

3) Representar a la empresa de manera profesional en eventos, conferencias y espacios de networking de la industria, realizando prospección activa y no solo atención pasiva de contactos.

4) Identificar y abrir conversaciones con los tomadores de decisión adecuados dentro de cada empresa. 

5) Calificar oportunidades comerciales, entendiendo las necesidades del prospecto, el fit con la solución y el potencial de negocio. 

6) Mantener información clara, completa y actualizada en el CRM sobre actividades, conversaciones, próximos pasos y avance de cada cuenta. 

7) Dar seguimiento constante a prospectos y oportunidades en etapa inicial del proceso comercial. 

8) Proponer nuevas empresas objetivo cuando identifique oportunidades relevantes dentro del mercado. 




¿POR QUÉ UNIRTE A ESTE EQUIPO?

· Se ofrece una compensación altamente competitiva, de acuerdo con tu experiencia y perfil, junto con un atractivo esquema de bonos basado en resultados, porque las contribuciones sólidas deben ser realmente recompensadas.

· En este rol tendrás la posibilidad de participar directamente en la expansión comercial de la compañía en México, trabajando con un producto tecnológico de alto valor y con un equipo internacional orientado a resultados, aprendizaje y crecimiento profesional.

· Además, es una posición ideal si buscas desarrollar una carrera comercial en tecnología B2B, fortalecer tus habilidades de prospección outbound, aprender sobre soluciones complejas y tener exposición real a clientes, eventos de la industria y procesos comerciales consultivos.

· La empresa ofrece un entorno dinámico, flexible y de baja burocracia, donde se valora la responsabilidad, la iniciativa, la transparencia, la capacidad de aprendizaje y la ejecución constante.




TRES CLAVES PARA EL ÉXITO EN ESTA POSICIÓN

1) Mentalidad hunter y fuerte capacidad de prospección outbound

2) Disciplina comercial y excelente manejo de CRM

3) Coachability, profesionalismo y confianza para representar a la empresa

Si te identificas con este rol y te motiva la oportunidad de generar nuevas conversaciones comerciales, abrir puertas con empresas objetivo y contribuir al crecimiento de una compañía internacional de tecnología en México y LATAM, nos encantará conocerte: cv@tk-recruitment.com

About the job

Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

About The Role

You own Product & Lifecycle Growth marketing for Everand and Fable, end to end. Everand is our audiobook and ebook subscription product; Fable is our book-tracking and discovery community. Both are built for people who love books and reading. You'll set the positioning, plan the launches, build and ship the campaigns yourself, and measure what they move.

This is a senior individual contributor role built for a self-starter who is energized by both the strategy and the build. You'll go from a launch narrative one day to building the campaign in Iterable the next, and you'll go hands-on whenever that's the fastest path to impact.

What You'll Do


Own positioning and messaging for Everand and Fable across features, launches, and seasonal moments, tailored to each brand's audience and stage.
Lead go-to-market for new features and product updates, from concept through launch and adoption.
Build and ship the campaigns yourself across email, push, and in-app in Iterable, including audience segmentation and technical setup.
Partner with the dedicated lifecycle team to align launch moments with the always-on program, and own member and brand communications across those moments.
Partner with Product and Brand to shape the roadmap and keep messaging consistent with each brand's voice.
Define the metrics, set targets, instrument tracking before launch, and report on impact.
Test and iterate on messaging, timing, and targeting, and turn what works into a repeatable playbook.
Contribute to growth across the funnel, partnering with Product and Brand.


What You'll Bring


6+ years in growth, lifecycle, or product marketing in a subscription or consumer product business, with hands-on campaign execution.
A track record of owning GTM strategy and shipping the execution yourself.
Hands-on experience building campaigns in a marketing automation platform (Iterable or similar).
Strong writing skills, with the ability to own brand voice and turn it into copy that ships.
Comfort self-serving in data: you can read a query or dashboard and use it to make decisions.
A founder/owner mindset, you move on a priority without waiting for a fully specified brief, and a genuine love of books and reading.


At Scribd, Inc., your base pay is one part of your total compensation package and is determined within a range. Our pay ranges are based on the local cost of labor benchmarks for each specific role, level, and geographic location. San Francisco is our highest geographic market in the United States.

In the state of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $144,000 [minimum salary in our lowest geographic market within California] to $216,500 [maximum salary in our highest geographic market within California].

In the United States, outside of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $119,000 [minimum salary in our lowest US geographic market outside of California] to $205,500 [maximum salary in our highest US geographic market outside of California].

In Canada, the reasonably expected salary range is between $151,000 CAD[minimum salary in our lowest geographic market] to $192,000 CAD[maximum salary in our highest geographic market].

We carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including but not limited to experience; job-related skill sets; relevant education or training; and other business and organizational needs. The salary range listed is for the level at which this job has been scoped. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for a competitive equity ownership, and a comprehensive and generous benefits package.

description:
About the job

Own a category like it is your own business. 📦




📍 Location: Remote, based in Mexico




💵 Compensation: $42,000–$55,000 USD/year base, plus performance bonuses tied to category profit and in-stock rate




LifeSupplyUSA is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce retailers of household essentials in the US: air filters, HVAC filters, extension cords, and home goods. We sell across Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, and Canada with a lean, high-performance remote team, and we are building a sharper, more scalable company with better dashboards, cleaner SOPs, and real ownership.




This is not a Catalog Manager role in the usual sense of listing maintenance or backend cleanup. This is a Category Merchant role: you own a P&L, you own pricing and in-stock calls, and you are measured on margin and category profit, not on tasks completed. If you are looking for your first marketplace role or a purely execution-level position, this is not it.




🎯 THE ROLE

You will own a defined block of our catalog (starting with extension cords, our largest category) like a P&L. You will know your category and your top competitors cold, watch your listings every day, and make the pricing, inventory, and advertising calls that protect rank and margin.

This is a judgment and ownership role. Not data entry. Not catalog cleanup. Not dashboard watching.




🔹 WHAT YOU WILL OWN

📊 Category P&L: in-stock rate, contribution margin, TACOS, and category profit. You run it like an owner.

🔎 Daily monitoring of your top SKUs: competitor pricing, deals and lightning deals, stock positions, Buy Box, and listing health.

💰 Pricing decisions within a clear rule set, including our low-stock governor (when a winner runs low, you decide whether to raise price or pull ad spend to protect rank instead of going out of stock).

📦 In-stock discipline on core winners, working with forecasting and sourcing so proven sellers are never starved.

🏷️ Listing quality: titles, images, A+ content, variations, and pack configurations.

♻️ Liquidation calls on end-of-life and slow-moving inventory.

📈 Channel growth: extend your winners onto Walmart, Shopify, and Canada.

🛠️ SOPs and decision trees that make the role scalable and repeatable.




🚫 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

It is not a data-entry or backend-keyword role.

It is not a catalog cleanup role.

It is not dashboard monitoring and forwarding problems to someone else.

It is not inventory forecasting.

It is not creative design.

It is not for someone who waits to be told what to do.

We already have catalog, compliance, inventory, creative, and operations support. We need someone who connects the dots and drives the action.




✅ WHAT YOU WILL BE MEASURED ON

High in-stock rate on A and B SKUs, with no preventable stockouts on winners
Contribution margin and category profit
TACOS and advertising efficiency
Days out of stock trending down over time
Underperforming SKUs turned into clear, documented action plans
Channel growth against revenue and margin goals




🧠 WHAT YOU NEED

✔ 3+ years running an Amazon Seller Central account, ideally owning a category or P&L

✔ Fluency in Amazon fees, FBA economics, Buy Box dynamics, and pricing. You can calculate a SKU's contribution margin in your sleep.

✔ Strong commercial judgment. You decide and own outcomes, you do not wait to be told.

✔ Comfort with Helium 10 or similar, Seller Central reporting, and spreadsheets

✔ Excellent written English and proactive remote communication, including flagging blockers before they become missed deadlines

✔ Ability to build and improve SOPs, checklists, and decision trees

✔ Walmart Marketplace a strong plus. Shopify or Canada a plus.

✔ Bonus: home, hardware, electrical, or commodity consumable categories

✔ Single full-time commitment, no other clients or roles




💪 YOUR AUTHORITY

Set pricing within the rule set, including low-stock governor calls
Make in-stock and liquidation decisions for your block
Create action plans and coordinate fixes across catalog, creative, inventory, compliance, and operations
Recommend listing, pricing, assortment, and channel improvements
Escalate true exceptions with clear context and a recommendation




📈 GROWTH PATH

Category Merchant ➜ Senior Category Merchant / Marketplace Manager ➜ Channel Lead / Marketplace Operations Lead.

We promote from within and reward ownership, judgment, and measurable results.




🌟 WHAT WE OFFER

💵 $42,000–$55,000 USD/year base, plus performance bonuses tied to category profit and in-stock rate

🌍 100% remote

🏖 Paid time off

📈 A real growth path

🎯 Real P&L ownership of an important category

🤝 A lean, high-performance team that values judgment, speed, and accountability




⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTES

🚫 No freelancers carrying other clients, no part-time

💼 Full commitment, no other roles

🧾 Gross pay, candidate handles their own taxes




📩 HOW TO APPLY

We do NOT accept applications through LinkedIn's apply button.

Email your resume to info@lifesupplyusa.com with the subject line:

Category Merchant: [Your Name]

In the body of your email, answer these three questions:

1️⃣ Briefly describe your hands-on experience managing e-commerce marketplace accounts (Amazon Seller Central, Walmart, Shopify, or international channels), including any time you owned a category or P&L.

2️⃣ Tell us about a time you spotted an underperforming SKU or channel from reports or dashboards. What did you notice, what action did you take, and what was the result?

3️⃣ Give an example of a time you coordinated with catalog, inventory, creative, operations, or leadership to fix a marketplace issue. How did you drive it?

Applications sent any other way, or missing answers to all three questions, will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete one short practical exercise before final review.

We are moving fast. Strong candidates will hear back quickly. ⚡

title: Manager, Customer Data Services
skills: Lead and develop a high-performing team. You will coach, grow, and hold a high bar for a team of seven Data Specialists, most of them early in their careers.
Own what your team produces. You will own the team’s quality and responsiveness metrics, spot-check work, and build the review habits that keep our output error-free.

description:
About the job

About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

Watershed is on a mission to drive meaningful climate action, and our Customer Data Services ("CDS") team plays a key role in making that possible. This team acts as data experts to some of the world’s largest and most influential companies, including Walmart, the Carlyle Group, and Stripe. The team helps customers understand Watershed’s data requirements, advises them on data best practices, transforms their data into Watershed’s templates, and documents the steps for traceability. This work gets customers’ data into the platform quickly and accurately, allowing them to spend more time on their sustainability goals.

As a Manager on the Customer Data Services team, you will lead a team of seven Data Specialists in the Mexico City branch of a globally distributed team. In this role, you will enable your team to deliver rigorous, high-quality data services to Watershed’s customers. In addition, you will own strategic initiatives that improve the quality and efficiency of how we deliver, including the integration of AI into the team’s workflows.

This is a unique opportunity to be an early leader within Watershed’s Mexico City office. As a key leader in this office, you will play a critical role in building an inclusive, supportive, and high-performance culture, not only for your team, but for the broader Mexico City office as a whole.

In this role, you will…


Lead and develop a high-performing team. You will coach, grow, and hold a high bar for a team of seven Data Specialists, most of them early in their careers. 
Own what your team produces. You will own the team’s quality and responsiveness metrics, spot-check work, and build the review habits that keep our output error-free. 
Coach your team on communication and customer-facing skills. You will review the customer communications, documentation, and presentations your team creates, coaching them on structure, tone, and delivery. When coverage is needed, you will step onto a customer call yourself. 
Drive day-to-day team operations. You will help the team prioritize work, manage capacity and coverage across a growing book of customers, and remove blockers. 
Support your team when they’re stuck. You will help Data Specialists think through data problems such as how to make a solution scale, where potential quality risks sit, and when to use certain tools. You will direct them to the right resources when the answer lives elsewhere. 
Own strategic initiatives that raise the bar. Each quarter you will take on workstreams that improve the quality, efficiency, and value of the team’s work. 
Lead your team through the AI transition. You will drive adoption and change management as AI reshapes how work gets done. 
Foster cross-functional collaboration. You will represent your team with Sustainability Advisory, Customer Success, and Project Management leadership on shared initiatives. 
Be an early leader in our Mexico City office. You will embody and champion Watershed’s operating principles, setting the tone for an inclusive, mission-driven, and high-performance team. 


You are a great fit for this role if…


You bring 8+ years of professional experience, including 2+ years of demonstrated success managing a services, operations, or customer-facing team, typically in a consulting environment or within B2B SaaS. 
You are a skilled manager who is motivated by coaching, hiring, and developing people who are early in their careers. 
You are customer-obsessed. You know how to set a high bar for quality delivery and help your team reach it. 
You are a strong operator who loves to get into the details, uses data to make decisions, and builds repeatable systems in high-growth environments. 
You are an excellent communicator and can coach others to be one. You can explain a complex situation simply to a senior audience, and you know how to raise the standard for how a team writes and presents to customers. You are comfortable stepping onto a customer call to cover for someone on your team. 
You are proficient in Excel. You can spot-check the accuracy of work, reconcile totals, and size the risk in a data decision. SQL and Python skills are a bonus. 
You have experience leveraging AI to drive efficiency and amplify impact. You are comfortable leading a team through that kind of change. 
You thrive in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. You bring an ownership mentality, curiosity, and a bias to action in everything that you do. 
You are fluent in written and verbal English. 


Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

description:
About the job

Bnberry is transforming the $87 billion travel tech industry by changing how hotels and resorts connect with guests worldwide. We're building DBS — a new kind of product that hotels adopt as a B2B SaaS business tool, and that travelers experience directly as a consumer-facing hotel booking journey.

This is not a Product Owner or delivery-management role focused on writing tickets and managing developers. Your mandate is to own DBS end-to-end, connecting three product areas that most companies keep separate: the guest-facing booking experience, the hotel-facing workflows and business value, and how travelers discover hotels through search and AI tools.

What You'll Own


 The consumer-facing booking journey — including the logic behind it: availability, rates, cancellation policies, and how PMS/CRS or booking-engine integrations shape what the guest sees
 Hotel-facing workflows tied to DBS: onboarding, reporting, and adoption
 The product capabilities that help hotels improve and measure visibility across search engines and AI discovery tools, in partnership with Marketing and relevant specialists
 Booking-funnel performance and conversion
 The link between guest experience and measurable hotel business value


What You'll Do


 Define product vision and roadmap for DBS, connecting guest booking UX, hotel workflows, and AI discovery into one coherent product
 Own the booking journey end-to-end — identify friction in calendars, date selection, room/rate selection, checkout, and confirmation, and understand how availability, rates, cancellation policies, and PMS/CRS or booking-engine integrations affect what the guest experiences; work with Engineering on dependencies and failure cases
 Translate hotel onboarding, reporting, and adoption needs into product decisions that show measurable business value to hotel customers
 Own the product capabilities behind search and AI/GEO visibility — partner with Marketing and relevant specialists on execution, while building enough SEO/GEO literacy to identify and prioritize the right product bets
 Interview hoteliers and travelers and run usability tests; translate qualitative and quantitative findings into clear priorities
 Define success metrics before building, and use experiment results to guide iteration
 Work closely with Design and Engineering through detailed user journeys, making trade-offs and shipping in small, practical iterations
 Align Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success around DBS priorities, and take responsibility for product outcomes


Requirements


 3+ years of product management experience owning customer-facing products, including relevant experience in hospitality technology or travel booking
 Relevant, demonstrable connection to the US market
 Hands-on customer research skills — hotelier and traveler interviews, usability testing, and translating findings into clear priorities
 Strong analytical and experimentation skills — diagnosing booking-funnel friction, testing improvements, and measuring booking conversion, hotel adoption, and retention
 Comfortable working through detailed user journeys with Design and Engineering, making trade-offs, and shipping in small iterations
 Able to operate independently with ambiguity, prioritize by customer and business value, and align Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success


What We're Looking For:

Industry-Grounded — You've worked in hotel technology, B2B hospitality platforms, or a B2C travel product with an actual booking journey. Deep exposure to hotel distribution systems is a plus, not a prerequisite — strong B2C travel/booking experience counts too.

US Market Fluent — You have demonstrable familiarity with US hotels or travel customers, whether through working with them directly or through living and studying in the US combined with hospitality experience.

Booking UX Owner — You understand the details of a booking flow — calendars, date selection, room and rate choice, checkout, confirmation — and the logic behind it: availability, rates, cancellation policies, and PMS/CRS or booking-engine integrations. You can spot friction before a customer complains about it.

Fluent in Both Guest and Hotel — You're as comfortable reasoning about a traveler's booking journey as you are about a hotelier's onboarding, adoption, and ROI.

Fast Learner on AI/SEO — You understand how travelers discover hotels through search and AI tools, and can pick up emerging SEO/GEO capabilities quickly enough to know which product bets are worth making — without needing to personally execute SEO.

Success Metrics

Examples include: booking conversion rate, hotel adoption of DBS, feature adoption, booking-funnel completion, search and AI/GEO visibility for hotels on DBS, customer and hotelier satisfaction, and retention.

Important Clarification

This role is not a traditional Product Owner responsible primarily for backlog management and task assignment. The focus is on owning DBS as a genuinely new product category — one that has to work as a business tool for hotels and as a booking experience travelers actually use.

Benefits


 Competitive salary plus equity package
 Define a new product category — DBS sits at the intersection of B2B SaaS, consumer booking, and AI discovery, largely undefined by competitors today
 Autonomy to experiment, take risks, and drive discovery
 Work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and a massive traditional industry

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
About the job

🚀 Buscamos un/a Customer Support Specialist L1 en México para sumarse a AgendaPro.




AgendaPro es la plataforma líder en LATAM para gestionar agenda, pagos y crecimiento en negocios de belleza, salud y bienestar, con más de 12 años creciendo y respaldo de Y Combinator y una Serie B de US$35M.




Estamos en plena transformación: pasamos de un SaaS horizontal a un modelo de verticales con agentes de IA, y estamos armando los equipos que van a llevar estas nuevas líneas de negocio al mercado. Es una etapa temprana donde todavía hay muchísimo por construir, probar y escalar y queremos que seas parte desde el principio.




Buscamos gente con ganas de aprender, actitud resolutiva y vocación de servicio, que entienda que detrás de cada conversación hay un emprendedor confiando en nosotros.




📍 Modalidad híbrida – con esquema de turnos: días presenciales con entrada a las 09:00 y fines de semana remoto.




Tu desafío: Ser la primera línea de soporte vía chat (Intercom) y resolver los problemas de nuestros clientes con rapidez, claridad y empatía. Cada conversación bien resuelta es un cliente que se queda.




🚀 Qué harás / Responsabilidades:

• Atención en Intercom (tu cancha principal): gestionar tu bandeja de conversaciones, tomar casos y responder en tiempo real.

• Comunicarte con clientes por chat (canal principal) y, ocasionalmente, por mail, teléfono o videollamada.

• Ser el reflejo de la marca en cada mensaje: claro, empático y paciente, sobre todo con clientes poco tecnologizados.

• Resolver consultas de usabilidad guiando al cliente paso a paso dentro de AgendaPro.

• Crear y documentar tickets internos con todo el detalle cuando corresponda.

• Trabajar junto a Tecnología y Producto para que los errores se resuelvan rápido, sin perder nunca el seguimiento con el cliente.

• Cumplir las métricas del área: CSAT, tiempo de primera respuesta (FRT), tiempo de resolución y productividad diaria.

• Participar en capacitaciones, QA y mejora continua de flujos y respuestas.




Requisitos:

• Pasión real por el servicio al cliente: no descansas hasta dejar al usuario con su problema resuelto.

• Excelente comunicación escrita en español: sabes explicar lo complejo de forma simple.

• Habilidad tecnológica básica: navegadores, correo, hojas de cálculo y varias pestañas/herramientas abiertas a la vez sin marearte.

• Comodidad para revisar configuraciones y guiar al cliente en las suyas.

• Proactividad, paciencia, empatía y aguante para manejar varias conversaciones a la vez.

• Disponibilidad para el esquema de turnos (presencial con entrada a las 09:00 y remoto los fines de semana).




Suma puntos (no excluyente):

• Experiencia en atención al cliente, ventas o customer success en empresas de tecnología / SaaS.

• Conocimiento de herramientas tipo Intercom, Zendesk o CRMs.

• Nociones de web, APIs, redes o tecnología en general.

• Inglés intermedio.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES

Liderar y coordinar equipos de planeación y ejecución de medios.
Distribuir cargas de trabajo, asignar responsabilidades, establecer tiempos y dar seguimiento a los entregables.
Dar dirección al equipo y asegurar la calidad de planes, reportes y resultados de campaña.
Monitorear KPIs y guiar al equipo en la transformación de datos de plataforma en insights claros.
Supervisar presupuestos de medios, seguimientos financieros y controles de inversión de las marcas.
Liderar reportes y conversaciones de desempeño con el cliente.
Gestionar expectativas, negociar tiempos y comunicar cuando una solicitud no sea viable.
Impulsar disciplina de procesos, responsabilidad y excelencia operativa.
Coordinarse con stakeholders globales y participar en comunicaciones en inglés cuando sea necesario.
Apoyar al liderazgo de la cuenta mediante la identificación proactiva de necesidades, riesgos y siguientes pasos.




REQUISITOS

Indispensables

Experiencia senior en medios digitales, planeación, performance o disciplinas relacionadas.
Experiencia comprobable liderando equipos, delegando trabajo y dando seguimiento a entregables.
Conocimiento sólido de planeación digital, desempeño de campañas, KPIs y reporting.
Experiencia en administración de presupuestos de medios y controles financieros.
Manejo avanzado de Excel, incluyendo bases de datos y macros.
Habilidades sólidas de gestión de cliente, comunicación y negociación.
Alto nivel de autonomía, proactividad, organización y toma de decisiones.
Inglés intermedio-avanzado para reuniones, documentos y relación con stakeholders globales.




Deseables

Conocimiento de medios offline, incluidos televisión, radio, OOH y métricas relacionadas como TRPs.
Experiencia con cuentas de tecnología, retail, comercio electrónico o electrónica de consumo.
Experiencia trabajando con stakeholders multinacionales o estructuras globales de agencia




INFORMACIÓN ADICIONAL

La persona seleccionada deberá estar orientada a procesos, ser altamente autónoma y sentirse cómoda liderando en contextos de ambigüedad. 
La posición requiere resiliencia, buen criterio y capacidad para hacer avanzar el trabajo sin esperar instrucciones detalladas, escalando riesgos y solicitando apoyo cuando sea necesario.

description:
About the job

About Tala

Tala is AI-native credit infrastructure for the global majority, combining proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. Backed by more than $500 million in funding, Tala has distributed more than $7 billion in capital to more than 13 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia—building one of the most robust datasets on thin-file borrowers anywhere in the world. Our mission is simple yet bold: to unleash the economic power of the global majority. We are looking for daring, data-driven leaders passionate about building the trust and credit infrastructure for the global majority.

Our pioneering work and proven impact have earned us consistent recognition, including being named to:

CNBC’s Disruptor 50 for five years.

CNBC’s World's Top Fintech Companies for two consecutive years.

Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for nine consecutive years.

Visionary investors, persuaded by the economic power of the global majority, have committed half a billion dollars in equity and debt to Tala's success.

Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.

Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

The Role 

TALA is looking for a dynamic and innovative Social Media and Creative Specialist to join our vibrant team and revolutionize our online presence. This role serves as the creative powerhouse behind our strategy, managing day to day posting and interactions, content development and creative ideas with a strong focus on TikTok and YouTube. Reporting directly to the Marketing Director this position offers an exciting opportunity to drive engagement, spearhead content creation, and explore novel avenues to amplify our brand across diverse social platforms

What You'll Do


Devise and execute engaging content strategies tailored for Meta, TikTok and YouTube
Manage daily interactions and engagements across social media platforms
Drive growth through follower acquisition, engagement, and community management
Identify and explore new social media channels and trends to expand our online presence
Develop and curate engaging content for social media platforms
Assist in the creation and editing of written, video, and graphic content
Attend events and produce live social media content
Maintain unified brand voice across different social media channels
Monitor social media channels for industry trends
Review analytics and create reports on key metrics



What You'll Need


Minimum of 5 years of experience in social media marketing, community management, content management or a similar role
In-depth knowledge of social media trends and platforms
Impeccable time management skills with the ability to organize and prioritize and meet deadlines
Proven experience in developing successful social media campaigns
Fluent in English (spoken and written) B2/C1 preferred
Track record of delivering projects and impact in a fast-paced environment



Nice to Have


Experience in the fintech industry, hospitality, advertising or related fields
Certificates of social media training from software like Facebook Blueprint, TikTok, Google University, Coursera, Domestika and/or similar



Our vision is to build a new financial ecosystem where everyone can participate on equal footing and access the tools they need to be financially healthy. We strongly believe that inclusion fosters innovation and we’re proud to have a diverse global team that represents a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and experience. We hire talented people regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Description -

Job Summary

The Senior Creative Technologist will help define how generative AI is used to create high-quality, scalable marketing content within HP's Content Transformation platform.

This role sits at the intersection of creative craft, marketing, generative AI, and production systems. The Senior Creative Technologist translates real marketing briefs and creative requirements into repeatable generation approaches across copy, imagery, video, templates, and other content formats.

This is not a pure prompt-writing role. The value of this position comes from combining strong creative judgment with a systems mindset: understanding what makes content effective, identifying why AI outputs succeed or fail, and converting those learnings into structured prompts, workflows, constraints, benchmarks, and reusable generation playbooks.

The role will work closely with Product Management, Platform Engineering, Adobe, designers, marketers, and other Creative Technologists to continuously improve the quality, consistency, efficiency, and production readiness of content generated through mAIstro.

Generative AI tools can create content quickly, but access to models alone does not create production-quality marketing content. HP needs Creative Technologists who can bridge the gap between marketing intent and AI execution.
