Creative quality and generation logic for assigned AI-enabled content use cases.
Structured prompt and reasoning approaches for copy, imagery, video, and multimodal generation.
Generation playbooks that define inputs, outputs, constraints, guardrails, expected variants, and regeneration behavior.
Creative evaluation of AI-generated outputs using clear design, brand, product, and production criteria.
Benchmarking and quality standards for AI-generated content.
Structured experimentation across models, prompting approaches, references, parameters, and workflows.
Diagnosis and reduction of recurring generation failure modes.
Template-fit logic, including copy limits, layout behavior, safe zones, asset requirements, and generation constraints.
Documentation of effective prompt patterns, workflow behavior, model characteristics, examples, and lessons learned.
Continuous improvement based on marketer, reviewer, and production feedback.
Practical enablement that helps marketers achieve stronger outputs without needing deep prompt-engineering expertise.


What This Person Does Not Own


Overall mAIstro product roadmap or marketer UI.
Final brand, legal, or product approval decisions.
End-to-end software architecture of the mAIstro platform.
Core application engineering, APIs, authentication, infrastructure, or deployment.
Enterprise workflow or project management.
Ownership of every creative deliverable.


The Senior Creative Technologist defines how AI-enabled creative capabilities should behave and perform. Product Management owns what should be built, and Platform Engineering owns how those capabilities are technically integrated and operated.

Experience, Knowledge & Skills


8+ years of experience in creative technology, visual design, art direction, creative production, motion design, content systems, digital production, or a related discipline.
Strong portfolio demonstrating high-level creative judgment across composition, hierarchy, typography, color, imagery, lighting, visual storytelling, motion, and digital content.
Hands-on experience using generative AI for professional creative production.
Demonstrated ability to create and optimize structured prompts and generation workflows.
Ability to evaluate creative outputs objectively and explain why one solution is stronger than another.
Strong understanding of modern creative production workflows across multiple content formats.
Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud applications such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Express.
Experience testing AI capabilities systematically and documenting findings.
Ability to operate independently in ambiguous, rapidly evolving technology environments.
Strong collaboration skills across creative, marketing, product, and technical teams.
Experience with Adobe Firefly, Firefly Services, Foundry, Express, or other advanced generative AI platforms.
Experience with leading image, video, and multimodal generation models.
Experience with LLM-based copy generation and reasoning workflows.
Experience designing reusable prompt or generation frameworks.
Familiarity with reference-image workflows, structured prompts, model parameters, seeds, metadata, and generation controls.
Experience with retouching, compositing, motion graphics, editing, or advanced image manipulation.
Experience supporting enterprise brands with strong governance requirements.
Understanding of APIs, automation, or workflow orchestration sufficient to collaborate effectively with engineers.


How Success Is Measured


Higher first-pass acceptance of generated content w/ fewer unnecessary regeneration cycles.
Reduction in recurring AI generation failure modes.
Improved consistency across products, markets, channels, and use cases.
Reusable generation playbooks adopted across multiple workflows.
Faster onboarding of new models and AI capabilities.
Strong collaboration between Creative Technology, Product, Engineering, Adobe, and marketing users.


The Profile We Are Looking For

You have strong creative taste, but you can explain it.

You can look at an AI-generated output and identify whether the problem is composition, lighting, hierarchy, motion, copy, product fidelity, prompting, source data, model capability, or workflow design.

You are comfortable moving between a creative review and a technical discussion.

You do not stop when AI produces something plausible. You iterate until the output is intentional, repeatable, and suitable for production.

Most importantly, you think beyond individual generations. Your job is to make the system better so that the next hundred generations are stronger than the first one.

description:
About the job

Tried & True Media

Full-Time Remote

About Tried & True Media

Tried & True Media is a performance marketing agency specializing in customer acquisition for e-commerce brands in the health and wellness space. With a data-driven approach across media buying, creative testing, funnel development, and performance optimization, TNT has generated over a billion dollars in sales for our customers.

We move fast, test constantly, and focus on one core outcome: helping our clients scale profitably.

About The Role

Tried & True Media is looking for a Paid Media Buyer / Traffic Manager to help manage, optimize, test, and scale paid media campaigns across our direct response e-commerce accounts.

This is a highly hands-on, executional role for someone who is excellent inside ad platforms and can make sound campaign decisions based on performance data.

You will partner closely with Performance Managers, who lead account strategy, client communication, and broader performance direction. Your role is to own the day-to-day media buying execution, including campaign launches, optimizations, budget and bid adjustments, testing, scaling, QA, troubleshooting, and performance analysis.Your primary objective is to manage paid media campaigns with precision, speed, and discipline so accounts can scale profitably.

The right person is a disciplined direct response media buyer who understands how to evaluate campaigns against funnel performance and profitability targets. This role requires speed, precision, strong analytical judgment, clean execution, and proactive internal communication.

Important Details

Location: 100% Remote

Schedule: 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. ET, with some flexibility based on location and business needs

Role Type: Full-Time

Primary Platforms: Meta and Google/YouTube, with potential exposure to TikTok, Snap, Pinterest, Bing, and other paid media channels

Primary Goal: Execute, optimize, and scale campaigns profitably

#1 Objective: Execute, Optimize, and Scale Campaigns Profitably

You will not be expected to own the client relationship. You will be expected to be a strong performance partner who can make high-quality campaign decisions and communicate clearly with internal stakeholders.

How Your Time Will Be Spent

Here’s an approximate breakdown of how you’ll spend your time:

55% Execution

Hands-on campaign builds, launches, optimizations, budget changes, bid adjustments, QA, troubleshooting, and account management inside Meta, Google, and other paid platforms.

25% Analysis

Reviewing campaign, ad set, ad, audience, creative, placement, geo, funnel, CPA, ROAS, spend, revenue, conversion rate, AOV, and conversion trends to determine what actions should be taken.

10% Testing & Scaling Support

Executing testing plans, identifying scaling opportunities, monitoring test results, and recommending next steps based on performance.

5% Creative Performance Feedback

Sharing clear observations on which creatives, hooks, angles, formats, placements, and messages are driving or limiting performance.

5% Documentation & Communication

Maintaining optimization notes, test logs, handoffs, and clear updates for Performance Managers and internal teams.

What You’ll Own

As a Paid Media Buyer / Traffic Manager, you will be responsible for the hands-on execution and performance management of paid media campaigns.

Your Responsibilities Will Include


Managing and optimizing paid media campaigns across Meta, Google (i.e.YouTube, Search, Pmax), and other platforms.
Executing campaign launches, budget changes, bid adjustments, scaling actions, creative tests, audience tests, and campaign structure updates.
Analyzing campaign performance daily and determining what actions need to be taken.
Making sound optimization decisions based on profitability, funnel performance, and client guardrails.
Partnering with Performance Managers to support account strategy and performance goals.
Monitoring campaign delivery, learning status, spend pacing, bid efficiency, creative fatigue, conversion trends, and account health.
Identifying opportunities to scale profitable campaigns.
Identifying underperforming campaigns, diagnosing likely causes, and taking appropriate action.
QA’ing campaign setup, links, events, conversion goals, naming conventions, budgets, bids, tracking parameters, and launch details.
Flagging tracking, pixel, attribution, or event-quality concerns when they may be impacting performance.
Providing clear performance notes and recommendations to Performance Managers.
Documenting major optimizations, tests, changes, and decision rationale.
Supporting creative testing by identifying which ads, formats, hooks, angles, or messages are driving performance.
Staying current on platform changes, bid strategies, optimization best practices, and performance trends.
Helping maintain clean, organized, and scalable ad account structures.


Requirements

5+ Years of Hands-On Paid Media Buying Experience

You have deep hands-on experience managing campaigns inside Meta and Google, ideally with $1M+ per month in paid media spend. Experience with direct response e-commerce, health and wellness, long form video is a strong plus.

Strong Campaign Optimization Skills

You know how to manage campaigns beyond surface-level changes. You understand budget scaling, bid strategy, campaign structure, audience testing, creative testing, conversion optimization, learning phases, and platform delivery.

Strong Analytical Judgment

You can identify patterns, understand performance movement, and make sound decisions without needing to be told every move to make.

Platform Execution Discipline

You are organized, detail-oriented, and careful with campaign setup.

Direct Response Performance Mindset

You understand key metrics, spend pacing, funnel performance, and profitability guardrails.You know that scaling is only valuable when it is profitable or aligned with the account’s agreed testing goals.

Testing And Scaling Experience

You have experience launching and managing tests across audiences, creatives, placements, bid strategies, campaign structures, and funnel paths.

description:
About the job

There are DTC brands that treat TikTok Shop as a side channel, and others that see it for what it actually is: the single highest-leverage lever in the business. This is the second kind. A family puzzle and games company that's found real traction on paid social in a category most competitors still run through wholesale, and is now betting that a small group of the right creators can take it to a category-defining scale.




Right now, TikTok Shop and creator and affiliate relationships are being managed reactively, alongside everything else. The goal with this hire is to change that: find, sign, train, and run the handful of creators who actually move the needle, and turn that into a repeatable engine feeding both TikTok Shop and Meta.




The math is simple, and the opportunity is real. One or two strong creators are already driving outsized results. The plan is to get to 50 of them, fed with great scripts, trained, motivated, and incentivized to keep posting, producing 1,000+ high-quality videos a month between them. That volume, repurposed into Meta ads, is the single biggest unlock this company has in front of it right now.




If you've run a large TikTok Shop from the inside, you know what separates a creator who posts once and disappears from one who becomes a real growth partner, and you're relentless about finding and developing the latter. This is the most important hire this company is making right now.




This is a fully remote, full-time role.




WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Own the entire creator and affiliate function. Full autonomy over sourcing, negotiating, onboarding, and roster management. This is a build-from-scratch seat, not a maintenance role.
Be the reason the flywheel works. Great scripts and a strong media buying team only matter if creators are actually posting consistently. You're the connective tissue that makes the whole model scale.
Real, uncapped upside. If the creator program hits its targets, it's the primary path to scaling this company to $100M+. Few hires anywhere have that kind of direct line to outcome.
Work with a proven playbook, not a hypothesis. The one or two creators already driving results prove the model works. Your job is to find the next 48, not invent the concept from zero.
A role built around shared upside. The structure is designed so your success and the program's GMV growth move together.




WHAT YOU'RE GETTING INTO

This role has two connected mandates. The primary one is building and running the creator and affiliate engine behind TikTok Shop, growing from a couple of proven creators to a roster of 50 who are consistently posting high-quality, high-performing content. The second is driving organic social output, high-volume content and video aimed purely at impressions and brand exposure, independent of the GMV-driving creator program.




You will:

Run mass outreach to identify, recruit, and sign TikTok Shop creators and affiliates, treating sourcing as a high-volume, ongoing pipeline rather than a one-time push
Evaluate creators quickly and accurately, knowing within a conversation or two who has the instincts, work ethic, and audience fit to become a real partner versus who's a one-off
Own onboarding and training, getting new creators up to speed on the brand, the products, and what "good" looks like on this account, while feeding them the best scripts and content direction from the creative team
Motivate and incentivize the roster to keep posting consistently, building the relationship management systems (comms cadence, incentive structures, recognition) that keep top performers engaged
Manage the commercial side of TikTok Shop, including commission structures, affiliate terms, and payouts, so the program is both attractive to creators and sustainable for the business
Track creator-level performance (GMV, video output, conversion), double down on what's working, and feed learnings back to the creative and growth teams so top content gets repurposed into Meta fast
Drive organic social output across brand channels as a separate lever from the creator and GMV program, pushing high volume of content purely for reach and impressions at effectively zero media cost




WHO YOU ARE

You've managed a large TikTok Shop, ideally one that did $5 million to $10 million+ in GMV, and you know the mechanics, the algorithm, and the creator ecosystem from the inside, not from a course
You're a grinder who treats outreach as a volume game. You can send the outreach, take the calls, and keep a pipeline of prospective creators moving without losing steam
You genuinely understand content and what separates a creator who converts from one who just has followers
You're hands-on with negotiation and relationship management, comfortable setting terms, holding creators accountable, and keeping them motivated over the long haul
You're organised enough to run 50 concurrent creator relationships without anyone falling through the cracks
You think in GMV and output, not vanity metrics. You know the program is working when the numbers say so, not when the content looks good
You move fast and are comfortable owning a function end-to-end with real autonomy




Bonus if you've:

Scaled a TikTok Shop affiliate or creator program from a handful of partners to dozens
Been a creator yourself, or worked close enough to the creator side to know what actually motivates them to keep posting
Fed TikTok Shop content into a broader paid social strategy, Meta in particular

description:
About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We're looking for a Head of Exchange Infrastructure to own the layer every Kraken product is built on: the matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, the algo engine and the API engine. Kraken grew up as a set of vertically integrated products, each with its own engine and its own APIs. This role consolidates them into a single exchange stack that serves every product and every interface. You will lead a team of four to five product managers, partnered with an engineering manager. It is a senior, independent team, which means you get leverage quickly and you are expected to stay close to the work.

The opportunity


Own the product vision and roadmap for the exchange layer: matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, algo engine and API engine
Lead and grow a team of four to five product managers, and set the bar for product craft across the layer
Lead the consolidation of multiple matching engines into one, starting with US derivatives, then international derivatives, then spot
Build interface-agnostic, so every product team and every interface can build on the same platform rather than their own
Define success metrics (p99 latency, throughput, uptime, resiliency) and hold teams accountable to them
Partner with engineering leaders across exchange and core infrastructure to sequence the migration without disrupting live markets
Partner with Risk and Credit Infrastructure so a client can hold one account and trade every product against it
Anticipate industry shifts and shape our platform to stay ahead
Align cross-functional teams (product, engineering, risk, compliance) around the exchange strategy


What You Bring


Senior product leader with experience in exchange, trading, or high-performance platforms
Experience managing and developing product managers, on a team senior enough to run without you in the room
Happy to be a player-coach. This team is independent, so you will own roadmaps and write specs yourself at times, not only review them
Proven ability to set product vision and translate it into a long-term roadmap
Strong understanding of matching engine and market data architecture, and the tradeoffs low latency forces
Experience building platforms for internal customers, with the judgment to tell a platform from a series of bespoke builds
Excellent communication skills — can influence technical and non-technical stakeholders
A passion for crypto markets, market structure, and building the next generation of infrastructure


Nice to haves


Engineering background before moving into product, so you've built or operated high-performance systems yourself and not just specced them
Experience across both spot and derivatives venues, with the market structure differences that come with each
Time at a crypto exchange operating at comparable scale, volume and uptime expectations
Track record building platform roadmaps that interlock with adjacent product orgs rather than running in isolation

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. title: Agency Growth Manager (Premium) - TikTok LIVE
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
The livestream industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become the next growth driver for TikTok global business. It also brings great joy to users globally and it creates a new channel for our creators to show themselves.

Responsibilities
Creators are at the center of our operations. Through professional agencies and MCNs in the content business, especially those that specialize in livestreaming, we are building scale and democratization of the livestreaming business. In this role of Agency Growth Manager, you will carry out two main sets of responsibilities that will drive business growth in a sustainable way:

Agency Management
 - Design TikTok LIVE LATAM's agency growth strategy for recruiting, retaining, and helping agencies scale up in their business on the platform. 
 - Design agency's benefit system and growth program to incentivize better performance and sustainable revenue growth.
 - Conduct day-to-day management directly with agency managers and their creators to materialize and iterate the strategic programs to deliver business results. Provide additional support to agencies and their creators for the needs related to content and platform guidelines. 
 - Build LIVE showcases with successful agencies and increase the positive impact of working with the platform in the agency community.
 - Collaborate with internal and cross-functional teams to carry out in-app and out-of-app campaigns and drive participation and results from agency creators.
 - Monitor results metrics for agency growth and performance, and conduct regular analysis to generate operational insights for improvement.

Agency Education and Capacity Building
 - Design LIVE's agency empowerment program with practical tips and know-how about how to scale up agency's operation and revenue potential with a focus on agency professionalization.
 - Facilitate business and industry knowledge transfer from top agencies to emerging agencies, learn from global best practices and localize the expertise to educate local agencies on how to scale.
 - Share the platform know-how on content tips and trends to agencies to improve their creators' LIVE performance and revenue generation.
 - Conduct training to agencies for the above mentioned topics, leveraging different tools and social platforms.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or above.
- More than 2 years of working experience relates to creator management, especially managing influencer agencies and/or MCNs.
- Candidates who are sensitive to cultural trends, possess a good understanding of the content industry, creator economy and business acumen on newly emerged industries are preferred. 
- Professional, patient, and skillful communication with talents/influencers. 
- Result-oriented and data-driven operation.
- Proficient in both verbal and written English since business communication with global teams are in English.

Preferred Qualifications
- Candidates who are used to work with, or have connections with modeling, content, media, TV, celebrities, and livestreaming platforms.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

Help document and improve internal processes so that good ways of working become repeatable across the team.

Hands-on social media coordination, publishing, community, content operations, or adjacent digital experience.

Strong attention to detail, especially around copy, timing, assets, approvals, account selection, links, platform requirements, and final pre-publish checks.

Comfort using social publishing tools, spreadsheets, project management systems, documentation, and other workflow tools.

Sound judgment about when to act independently, when to ask, when to escalate, and when not to publish.

You improve the operating system around the work: checklists, documentation, calendar views, QA steps, escalation routes, reporting, and lessons learned.

You make the team calmer and more effective because the details are visible, controlled, and followed through.
You enjoy the operational side of social media: coordination, publishing, QA, process, timing, and follow-through.
You like using modern tools to make repeated work more reliable.
You care about accuracy and client trust as much as you care about ideas.
You are comfortable working across multiple accounts and deadlines without losing detail.
You want to work in an AI-native team and are ready to bring those methods into everyday social media coordination.
You can take feedback, improve your process, and keep raising your own standard.
You mainly want a creative strategy role with little day-to-day coordination.
You are uncomfortable with detailed checks, repeated processes, or publishing accountability.
You treat AI-generated output as finished work without reviewing it.
You wait for someone else to notice problems that you could reasonably have surfaced.
You prefer broad social media opinions over client-safe execution and evidence-backed recommendations.
description:
About the job

🇲🇽 USD 18,000 to USD 22,000 per year, depending on experience, on a full time, contractor contract

🌎 Fully remote working from anywhere in Mexico!

✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment

💻 Work with modern hardware, social publishing tools, productivity systems, and AI-enabled workflows.




The standard hours for this role are 3pm-12am PT, Monday to Friday. 




Who We Are 




Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.

Our work sits at the intersection of media, technology, creativity, and operations. We produce social content at scale, support major entertainment brands, build products, and keep improving how our teams work.




We are remote-first, fast-moving, and increasingly AI-native in how we operate. AI tools and agentic workflows are becoming part of the way our teams plan, check, coordinate, research, report, and improve work. The standard is not “let AI do it”. The standard is better work: clearer briefs, faster execution, sharper checks, stronger judgment, and repeatable workflows that keep quality high.




About The Role 




We are hiring an AI Social Media Coordinator to help run the day-to-day social presence of major US TV and entertainment brands.

The craft is familiar: scheduling, reviewing, coordinating, optimising, checking, escalating, and keeping content moving. How we do that work is changing fast.




This is not a pure creative content role and it is not passive admin. The core of the job is client-safe social media operations: making sure content is scheduled, checked, approved, published, documented, and improved with strong attention to detail.




You will first learn what good looks like for our clients and why it matters. Then you will work with Storm’s social tools, workflow systems, and AI-enabled ways of working to help make the role faster, clearer, and more reliable.




The strongest candidates will already be practical and curious about AI. We are not looking for someone who uses AI only as a search box or autocomplete. We are looking for someone who can brief tools carefully, use them for bounded pieces of work, review what comes back with a critical eye, and keep improving how they use them.




If that already feels like how you work, this role is likely to suit you.




What You’ll Make Happen 

Put the client experience and publishing accuracy at the heart of everything you do.
Optimise YouTube content with effective titles, thumbnails, copy, metadata, and publishing checks.
Schedule, review, and coordinate social content across YouTube channels and social networks.
Support day-to-day community management across client social channels by monitoring and responding to audience comments and messages in line with agreed brand guidance, and escalating sensitive or complex interactions appropriately.
Clear dependencies proactively, including assets, copy, captions, approvals, account access, platform requirements, timings, and client expectations.
Coordinate with client contacts and Storm’s content production, copywriting, captioning, and social teams so work moves without avoidable gaps or surprises.
Use AI tools and workflow systems to support repeatable coordination work, including calendar planning, dependency chasing, content checks, research, account audits, reporting, and documentation.
Review AI-assisted work critically before it reaches clients, platforms, or internal stakeholders.
Research clients’ shows, movies, channels, competitors, and audiences so social recommendations are grounded in useful context.
Monitor social platform updates and identify practical changes that matter for client accounts.
Help document and improve internal processes so that good ways of working become repeatable across the team.
Escalate clearly when something is blocked, risky, unclear, late, or outside your authority, bringing evidence and a sensible next step.




Your Expertise 

Hands-on social media coordination, publishing, community, content operations, or adjacent digital experience.
Practical AI fluency: you have used AI tools in real work, study, or personal projects, and can explain how you check their output.
Strong attention to detail, especially around copy, timing, assets, approvals, account selection, links, platform requirements, and final pre-publish checks.
Clear written communication and the ability to explain what is done, what is blocked, what is risky, and what needs a decision.
Strong organisation and workload management across multiple accounts, deadlines, and stakeholders.
Comfort using social publishing tools, spreadsheets, project management systems, documentation, and other workflow tools.
A systems mindset: you see repeated work as something that can be made clearer, safer, and more efficient.
Curiosity about social platforms, audience behaviour, entertainment brands, and the changing AI tooling landscape.
Sound judgment about when to act independently, when to ask, when to escalate, and when not to publish.
Ability to analyse information qualitatively and quantitatively, then turn it into useful recommendations.
High agency: you do not wait passively for perfect instructions when there is a sensible next step to take.




What Success Looks Like 

Content goes out on the right account, at the right time, with the right assets, copy, metadata, approvals, and platform checks.
Client contacts and internal teams trust you because your updates are clear, accurate, and useful.
You catch issues early: missing assets, unclear approvals, broken links, platform constraints, scheduling conflicts, weak copy, mismatched account details, or risky assumptions.
You use AI and workflow tools to make repeatable work faster and more reliable, without handing over judgment.
You improve the operating system around the work: checklists, documentation, calendar views, QA steps, escalation routes, reporting, and lessons learned.
You distinguish urgent execution from optional strategy, and you know how to keep both moving at the right level.
You make the team calmer and more effective because the details are visible, controlled, and followed through.




This Role Will Suit You If

You enjoy the operational side of social media: coordination, publishing, QA, process, timing, and follow-through.
You like using modern tools to make repeated work more reliable.
You care about accuracy and client trust as much as you care about ideas.
You are comfortable working across multiple accounts and deadlines without losing detail.
You want to work in an AI-native team and are ready to bring those methods into everyday social media coordination.
You can take feedback, improve your process, and keep raising your own standard.




This Role Will Not Suit You If

You mainly want a creative strategy role with little day-to-day coordination.
You are uncomfortable with detailed checks, repeated processes, or publishing accountability.
You treat AI-generated output as finished work without reviewing it.
You wait for someone else to notice problems that you could reasonably have surfaced.
You prefer broad social media opinions over client-safe execution and evidence-backed recommendations.




What It’s Like to Work Here 




Modern Tools And Working Methods

Work with current hardware, social tools, productivity systems, and a properly supported AI stack. You will be expected to learn the tools, use them thoughtfully, and help improve how the work gets done.




Agility And Openness For Ideas

We actively encourage people to bring forward ideas that improve how teams work. We value practical experimentation, quick learning, and clear follow-through.




Client And Audience Impact

Our work supports major entertainment brands. Small details can matter: timing, approvals, links, copy, thumbnails, account selection, and platform rules all affect trust.




Remote-First Working

This role is fully remote within Mexico. Your normal workday will start at 3pm Pacific Time.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS 




First, you will receive questions to answer via a self-recorded video.




If successful, we will invite you to an interview (60 minutes via MS Teams). During the meeting, Bella, our Head of Social Media Management, will get to know you and try to understand if you’d be a good fit for the role, and at the same time answer all your questions.




Following this, there will be a short task to test your attention to detail and communication skills.

There may also be a short (30 minutes via MS Teams) follow-up interview with Duncan, our Chief Operating Officer.




And that’s it!
